limitations: Deterministic proxy, not a second human annotator.
The lexicon covers the committed English/German/French fixtures, not arbitrary prose.
Advisory counterpart guards are reported but not applied to the dataset.
AT-07 remains partial until a real second human review exists.
method: Independent bounded lexicon plus schema-evidence rules. The script parses each committed DDSP and re-derives concepts, paths, alternatives, forbidden guards and blocks from the prompt and schema; it never reads the author's expected paths to derive an answer. It is deterministic and makes no model calls.
